description: List a dealer's current public offers, stalest first by default, with prices, stock and verification status, observation timestamps, and computed age. Use this as a self-service stale-offer audit.

dealerId.description: Dealer ID or slug (e.g., 'jm-bullion', 'JM Bullion', or 'jmbullion.com').

inStockOnly.description: If true, return only offers whose stock status is in_stock.

limit.description: Maximum number of offers to return (default 50, hard cap 100).

offset.description: Number of stalest-first offers to skip (default 0).

name: list_dealer_offers
title: List Dealer Offers
